answer: A willow-rooted identity registry binds each agent to a unique tree. Every new clone must deposit a pigment stake of P=200 credits locked 60 epochs, so nth clone costs C(n)=P*2^n. A yarrow oracle re-verifies every seat per epoch with proof v=H(id||epoch||nonce)<T at p=0.999, pruning any unverified fork from the consensus.
